gitCommit.subject: fix: increase timeout to 45 min and add closed-context guards
gitCommit.body:
fix: increase timeout to 45 min and add closed-context guards

- playwright.config.ts: global timeout 10 min → 45 min
- badminton-booking.spec.ts: test.setTimeout 10 min → 45 min; add
  page.isClosed() checks after retry waits and between locations so
  a dead browser context fails cleanly instead of throwing cryptic
  addCookies errors; extend waitUntilBookingOpens window to 10 min
- ActivitiesPage.ts: switch slot selector to a[href*="/slot/"] (more
  reliable); add networkidle wait before scanning slots; improve
  navigateDirectlyToTimetable with 404-body detection
- LoginPage.ts: dismiss cookie banner and wait for login button
  before clicking to avoid race on SPA homepage
- debug-flow.spec.ts: expand debug flow with timetable inspection,
  iframe/shadow-DOM checks, and slot selector verification

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
